required_environment._why: audit_experiments/null_controls.py derives each draw's seed from Python's hash() of the control's name. Python salts string hashes per process unless PYTHONHASHSEED is fixed, so an unset value produces different (still valid, but different) draws. Under PYTHONHASHSEED=0 the Null D seeds are 130000-130999.

hardware.analysis_layer: CPU only; produced on a 64-core x86-64 host

determinism: Randomness enters only through seeded resamplers and seeded learners. No result depends on wall-clock time or process scheduling.
